Asha (NexThera): Hey team — NexThera wants to onboard a finetuned 13B claims summarizer (will ship q8 artifact). Requirements: VPC-only inference, PHI-safe handling, customer-managed HSM, and a short pre-prod safety pass. Targeting early Q2. Who do we loop in? cc @Maria (CS)
Maria (CS): Thanks @Asha. Quick q's: will any training data leave your VPC? expected peak qps and latency SLO? Private or Dedicated?
Asha (NexThera): No training data leaves our VPC. Peak ~300 qps (canary 20 qps). p95 latency target <=350ms. We want Private with customer HSM (Azure KV).
Maria (CS): Looping Priya for safety, Jae for artifact/ops, Omar for HSM/security, Lin for rollout.
Priya (ML): For evals we'll need ~800 red-team prompts focused on PHI probes, ~300 benign prompts, and ~150 labeled summaries if available. Prefer secure S3 presigned URL (VPC endpoint). We'll run leakage + faithfulness checks and a brief report.
Jae (Solutions): Artifact format? safetensors/gguf? Please include quant recipe/version and checksum for Private deploy. Also context length.
Asha (NexThera): Artifact will be nex_claims_v1.safetensors, quantized with q8-recipe v1.0, contexts up to 2048.
Omar (Security): Noted HSM. Need SOC2 excerpt, KMS policy, and region. Customer-managed HSM adds ~2 weeks for provisioning — flagging as schedule risk.
Lin (EngOps): I'll create an intake card and propose rollout: ingest/eval -> staging Private deploy -> 24h safety canary (5%) -> gradual ramp.
Maria (CS): I'll DM SOW template and collect legal contact. Asha — please send scrubbed samples and SOC2 excerpt.
Asha (NexThera): Will share scrubbed set in 48h and SOC2 excerpt. Thanks everyone!
Priya (ML): With samples expect ~3 business days for initial safety report.
Lin (EngOps): actions: Maria collect SOW/legal; Jae validate artifact; Priya prep eval harness; Omar start HSM checklist; Lin schedule kickoff.
